requirement:
修复订单管理、用户管理和寄存服务的线上 hotfix。
线上出现订单状态不同步、用户信息丢失和寄存价格计算错误的问题。
需要紧急修复相关服务的数据处理逻辑。

details.name: ts-consign-price-service
details.rationale: Directly responsible for consignment price calculation, likely needs fix for price errors.

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Order status synchronization issues likely involve the core order service that admin-order-service manages.

details.name: ts-consign-service
details.rationale: Consignment service handles luggage/consign operations, likely where price calculation errors occur.

details.name: ts-admin-user-service
details.rationale: User information loss directly relates to admin user management service.

details.name: ts-user-service
details.rationale: Core user data service that admin-user-service depends on for user info.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Handles other order types and may share order status logic with admin-order-service.

details.name: ts-admin-basic-info-service
details.rationale: May be involved in admin operations but less directly related to the specific issues.

details.name: ts-admin-route-service
details.rationale: Route admin service unlikely to be affected by order/user/consign hotfix.

details.name: ts-admin-travel-service
details.rationale: Travel admin service unlikely to be affected by order/user/consign hotfix.
